scenes.setting: The World does what The Fool cannot: lends the All-Black Eye for a price and a return date, while Alger drills Derrick on staging the confrontation; then Fors buys her answer — the Apprentice pathway belongs to the Abraham family, who bear a bloodline curse — and the floor turns to gossip, where Audrey opens with the Hero Bandit Dark Emperor
scenes.text_anchor: “I have an item that contains the mental corruption of the True Creator.”
